landing.heroText: Our AI agent finds products people actually want, verifies the discount is genuine against real market prices, and opens group deals. Group fills up — everyone gets a coupon code for the supplier's own site.
landing.how1Text: Browse the catalog and hit “I want this”. Demand is what wakes the AI up.
landing.how2Text: It verifies the price is honestly discounted for your location, computes a win-win price, and opens a group with a deadline.
landing.how3Text: When the group hits its target, every member gets a personal coupon code to redeem on the supplier's website.
landing.trustText: Every decision the agent makes is logged with reasons. Prices are computed by deterministic code the AI can't override, and suppliers who fake discounts get blocked automatically.
landing.trust1: Discounts measured against 90-day price history and market references — inflated “regular prices” don't count
landing.trust2: Never below the supplier's floor price — a win-win by construction
landing.trust3: Purchasing-power aware: a fair price in Tel Aviv isn't the same as in Mumbai
landing.trust4: Kill switch, action caps, and a full audit trail
